scenes.speaker: PASTOR DALE
scenes.line: I know that ache, friend. I carried it too.

scenes.speaker: PASTOR DALE
scenes.line: The world says it's who you are. We say — it's a weight you can set down.

scenes.speaker: MARCUS
scenes.line: I tried everything. I thought this was just me.

scenes.speaker: MARCUS
scenes.line: Then Pastor Dale showed me the Program. Now I'm flourishing.

scenes.speaker: PASTOR DALE
scenes.line: Three gentle steps: confess it, submit it, let us hold it for you.

scenes.speaker: PASTOR DALE
scenes.line: Won't you come home — to the self He meant you to be?

scenes.speaker: CROWD
scenes.line: the new you — brighter, lighter, good as true!

scenes.speaker: ANNOUNCER
scenes.line: Operators of grace are standing by. Call now!

scenes.speaker: ANNOUNCER
scenes.line: Three easy payments of yourself. Supplies of you may run dry.

scenes.speaker: ANNOUNCER
scenes.line: …not therapy, not a cure… your old self may not be recoverable…
